bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=13cfc4ef03e74b96795dc4008c94eda4de0a76d1
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo DM_SOURCE_FETCH_FAILED;exit 61; }
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || { echo DM_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH;exit 62; }
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo DM_POSTGRES_NOT_UNIQUE;exit 63; }
existing="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' || true)"
test -z "$existing" || { echo DM_CREATOR_CONSUMER_ALREADY_RUNNING;exit 64; }
secret_src="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$pg")"
test -f "$secret_src" && test ! -L "$secret_src" || { echo DM_POSTGRES_OWNER_SECRET_MISSING;exit 65; }
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
test -n "$user" || { echo DM_POSTGRES_OWNER_MISSING;exit 66; }
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test "$net" = "deploy_default" || { echo DM_POSTGRES_NETWORK_UNVERIFIED;exit 67; }
token_file="$(python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,re,stat,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
candidates=[]
for folder in (Path.home()/'.config'/'create-videobot',):
 if not folder.is_dir():continue
 for f in folder.iterdir():
  try:
   st=f.lstat()
   if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_mode & 0o077 or not 35<=st.st_size<=512:continue
   if any(x in f.name.lower() for x in ('session','userbot','oauth','phone')):continue
   token=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
   if not re.fullmatch(r'\d{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}',token):continue
   req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/getMe',
     data=b'{}',method='POST',headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
   with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as resp:obj=json.load(resp)
   x=obj.get('result')
   if obj.get('ok') and x and x.get('is_bot') and str(x.get('username','')).lower()=='createvdobot':
    candidates.append(str(f))
  except Exception:continue
if len(candidates)==1:print(candidates[0])
PY
)"
test -n "$token_file" || { echo DM_CREATOR_TOKEN_NOT_VERIFIED;exit 68; }
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
mkdir -p "$target"
chmod 700 "$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot" "$target"
git archive "$src" | tar -xf - -C "$target"
test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" || { echo DM_POLL_SOURCE_NOT_STAGED;exit 69; }
buildlog="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-creator-build.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$buildlog"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network host --pull=false \
  -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:local-poll "$target" >"$buildlog" 2>&1;then
 echo DM_POLL_DOCKER_BUILD=FAILED
 grep -Ei 'failed|error|denied|network|unavailable' "$buildlog" | tail -n 6 | sed -E 's#https?://[^ ]+#URL_REDACTED#g' || true
 exit 70
fi
echo DM_POLL_DOCKER_BUILD=PASS
db_exists="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='\''videobot'\''"')"
if test "$db_exists" != 1;then
 docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE DATABASE videobot"' >/dev/null || { echo DM_POLL_DB_CREATE_FAILED;exit 71; }
fi
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="\token_file"
export VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$secret_src"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo DM_POLL_COMPOSE_START_FAILED;exit 72; }
sleep 7
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" != true;then
 echo DM_POLL_CONTAINER_NOT_RUNNING
 docker logs --tail 20 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+=|^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+$' | tail -n 10 || true
 exit 73
fi
echo DM_POLL_CONTAINER=RUNNING
docker logs --tail 80 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_(DM|GATE|POLL)_' | tail -n 18 || true
if ! docker logs --tail 80 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then
 echo DM_POLL_READY_NOT_VERIFIED
 exit 74
fi
echo DM_POLL_READY=PASS
